items.title: Parabilis Medicines sets biotech record with $670m IPO
items.summary: Parabilis’ US listing means the biotech IPO record has been broken twice in as many months as public listings continue hot streak.

items.title: Enhance clinical trial screening and improve patient matching accuracy
Coya Therapeutics CEO on ALS urgency and fast-tracking COYA 302 for patient impact
items.summary: As CEO of Coya Therapeutics, Dr Arun Swaminathan is steering the company’s lead programme, COYA 302, an immune-modulating combination designed to restore regulatory T-cell function and dampen neuroinflammation, through a pivotal stage of development in ALS.

items.title: Eli Lilly continues dealmaking roll with $1bn AlzeCure agreement
items.summary: If AlzeCure-developed ACD680 reached the market, it would deepen Eli Lilly’s Alzheimer’s legacy past anti-amyloid-beta therapy, Kisunla.

items.title: Aditxt and Ignite announce merger plans with strategic partner
items.summary: Aditxt and subsidiary Ignite Proteomics have announced plans for a business combination with a strategic partner.
